dialogue.content: こんにちは相談員です。本日はお越し頂きありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: はじめにあなたの年齢と性別をお聞かせいただけますか？
dialogue.English: To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: はじめまして４０代女です
dialogue.English: Nice to meet you. I'm a woman in my 40s.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 結婚について将来が不安で相談に来ました
dialogue.English: I'm here because I'm anxious about my future regarding marriage.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。将来が不安に思われているんですね…それだと、心が疲れてしまいますね…
dialogue.English: I see. You're feeling anxious about the future... That must be mentally exhausting for you.

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: お話できる範囲で構いませんので、不安と思われる少し詳しい状況をお教えいただけますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: As much as you're comfortable sharing, could you please tell me a little more about the situation that's making you anxious?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 結婚について不安というお話だったのですが、今はご結婚はされておりますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned being anxious about marriage. Are you currently married?

dialogue.content: 現在お付き合いしてる人もいるんですが先が見えないお付き合いで他にアプローチしてくる方もいて老後も不安でどうしていいのかわからなくなってしまって
dialogue.English: I'm currently dating someone, but I don't see a future in the relationship. There are other people approaching me as well, and I'm anxious about my old age, so I just don't know what to do.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね…老後が不安と思われているのですね…
dialogue.English: I see... So you're feeling anxious about your old age...

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 現在おつきあいされている方とは、どれくらいお付き合いされていますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How long have you been dating your current partner?

dialogue.content: 一年半です
dialogue.English: For a year and a half.

dialogue.content: 相手は独身なのですがお父さんの介護もあって同棲も難しいですし
dialogue.English: He's single, but he's also caring for his father, which makes it difficult for us to even live together.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね…介護大変ですね…でも介護をされているという事は、親の面倒をよくみるお優しい方なのですね。
dialogue.English: I see... Caregiving must be very difficult... But the fact that he is a caregiver shows that he is a kind person who takes good care of his parents.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お付き合いしている方の年齢は、同年齢位のお方でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is your partner around the same age as you?

dialogue.content: とても優しいので一緒になっても養えないとは言われてて
dialogue.English: He's very kind, but he has told me that he wouldn't be able to support me even if we were together.

dialogue.content: 年は同じくらいです
dialogue.English: We're about the same age.

dialogue.content: 金銭面を、気遣ってそのように言われるのですね…
dialogue.English: So he says that out of concern for the financial aspect...

dialogue.content: 他にアプローチをされておられるとのお話でしたが、その方はどのような方でしたか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned there are others approaching you—what are they like?

dialogue.content: 変に幸せにするからなんていう人より全然いいとおもいます正直なので
dialogue.English: I think he's much better than someone who makes empty promises about making me happy, because he's honest.

dialogue.content: 本当に、そうだと思います。お付き合いされている方は、ものすごく実直でお優しい方なのだと感じました。
dialogue.English: I completely agree. It sounds like your partner is an incredibly honest and kind person.

dialogue.content: 二人いて一人は価値観合わない独裁者的な経営者でもう一人は機械の設計士で車もいいもの乗っていて温厚な方ですね
dialogue.English: There are two of them. One is a dictatorial business owner whose values don't align with mine, and the other is a mechanical engineer who drives a nice car and is mild-mannered.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。どちらの方に、ご興味を強く感じられますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Which of them are you more interested in?

dialogue.content: 設計士ですね安定はしてるので
dialogue.English: The engineer, because he seems stable.

dialogue.content: 安定していると、思われるのですね。お付き合いしている彼氏様は、現在お勤めはされていますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So you feel he is stable. Is your current boyfriend employed?

dialogue.content: しています
dialogue.English: Yes, he is.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。勤められているお仕事については、どのように思われますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. How do you feel about the work he does?

dialogue.content: 総合建築２０年以上していてサラリーマンです
dialogue.English: He's been a salaried employee at a general construction company for over 20 years.

dialogue.content: 全然いいと思ってます
dialogue.English: I think it's perfectly fine.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。長く一緒のところに働かれているのですね。それは、ご安心ですね。
dialogue.English: I see. He's been working at the same place for a long time. That's reassuring.

dialogue.content: 一緒ではないですよ全く別なので私は接客です
dialogue.English: No, we don't work together; it's completely separate. I work in customer service.

dialogue.content: 申し訳ございません…一つの会社で長く働かれているという、ご内容でした…
dialogue.English: My apologies... I meant that he has been with one company for a long time.

dialogue.content: 全然別です
dialogue.English: It's completely separate.

dialogue.content: 今、接客業をされているのですね。今働かれているお仕事については、どのように思われていますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So you're currently in customer service. How do you feel about your current job?

dialogue.content: 自分のですかそれとも相手の
dialogue.English: Mine or his?

dialogue.content: 仕事に関してはなんとも思ってないので
dialogue.English: I don't really have any particular feelings about my job.

dialogue.content: 相談者様のお仕事について、やりがいを感じておられるお仕事ですか？
dialogue.English: Do you find your work rewarding?

dialogue.content: 特にないですね仕事は
dialogue.English: Not particularly.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。お教えいただき、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: I see. Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 将来について、こうなれば良いなと思う事はありますか？
dialogue.English: Looking toward the future, is there anything you hope for?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Well...

dialogue.content: 難しいし時間もかかるとはおもうけど今の彼が落ち着いたら一緒に暮らせたらとは考えてます確かに安定した人は魅力ですけど
dialogue.English: I know it will be difficult and take time, but I hope that once my current boyfriend's situation settles down, we can live together. Of course, a stable person is appealing, too.

dialogue.content: カウンセラーさんはホントに好きな人と安定どちら選びますか？状況にもよるとおもうけど
dialogue.English: Counselor, would you choose someone you truly love, or someone who is stable? I suppose it depends on the situation, though.

dialogue.content: そうですね…結婚するとしたらですよね…
dialogue.English: Let's see... If it were for marriage, you mean...

dialogue.content: まあその時のタイミングもあるとも思います
dialogue.English: Well, I think timing is a factor too.

dialogue.content: タイミング、その通りだと思います…
dialogue.English: Timing, that's absolutely right...

dialogue.content: 一緒にいて価値観合わない人間とはいくら安定してても無理だとおもてるんで
dialogue.English: I feel that no matter how stable someone is, it's impossible to be with them if your values don't align.

dialogue.content: でも経験上、結局どちらを選んだとしても、良い面と悪い面は必ずあると思います…
dialogue.English: But from my experience, whichever you choose, there will always be both good and bad aspects...

dialogue.content: 継続できないと意味がないですしきっと金の切れ目が縁の切れ目金がなくなったら全く魅力もないとおもうので私だけかも知れませんが
dialogue.English: If it can't be sustained, it's meaningless. There's a saying, 'When the money's gone, so is the love.' If the money ran out, I think the attraction would disappear completely—but maybe that's just me.

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: That's true, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 私もそれに激しく同意します
dialogue.English: I strongly agree with that.

dialogue.content: 共感していただいて嬉しいです
dialogue.English: I'm happy you can relate.

dialogue.content: でもお金も、本当に大切だと思います笑
dialogue.English: But money is also really important, I think. (laughs)

dialogue.content: それはとてもおもいます
dialogue.English: I really think so.

dialogue.content: 同時進行とかよくないのかなとも思いながら考えてしまいます設計士のほうは彼がいるの知っていて
dialogue.English: I wonder if it's wrong to pursue things with both at the same time, but I can't help thinking about it. The engineer knows I have a boyfriend.

dialogue.content: 考えられてしまうお気持ちは、非常によく分かります。自分のお幸せを第一に考えて欲しいので、他の方をよく見極めるのも良い事だと思います。
dialogue.English: I can very much understand why you'd be thinking about it. I want you to prioritize your own happiness, so I think it's a good thing to carefully consider your other options.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: お話をお聞きしていて、そうやって色々な方からアプローチもされ、きっと相談者様はすごく魅力的な方だろうなと想像が出来ます。
dialogue.English: Listening to your story, and hearing how various people are approaching you, I can imagine you must be a very charming person.

dialogue.content: そうですよね彼がいながらマッチングやらしてしまうこともあってちょっとおかしいのかなという気持ちも確かめるため相談に来たので
dialogue.English: Right. I came here to talk today partly to see if there's something wrong with me, because I find myself using dating apps even though I have a boyfriend.

dialogue.content: 全然大丈夫だと思います！実は私も同年代なので、若い頃とは結婚という認識が異なると考えております。
dialogue.English: I don't think there's anything wrong with that at all! Actually, I'm around the same age, and I think our perspective on marriage is different from when we were younger.

dialogue.content: お話し聴いてくださってとても嬉しいですやっぱり自分のこともっと考えてくれる人がいればもしかしたらということはあるかもしれません
dialogue.English: I'm so glad you've listened to me. I guess if there was someone who would think more about me, then maybe... things could be different.

dialogue.content: この前も正月勝手に自分だけで決めて男同士で旅行いってて２回正月迎えましたが年末年始一緒に過ごすことなかったんで流石に怒りましたw
dialogue.English: Just the other day, he decided on his own to go on a trip with his male friends over New Year's. This is the second New Year's we've been together, and we've never spent the holidays together, so I finally got angry with him (lol).

dialogue.content: そうなんですね…それは、年始から腹立たしいですね…
dialogue.English: I see... That must have been frustrating, right at the start of the year...

dialogue.content: 怒ったら、どういう反応をされてましたか？
dialogue.English: When you got angry, how did he react?

dialogue.content: みんなに言われますひどいねってだから余計もっと安定してて自由過ぎない考えてくれる人がいたらとかんがえてました
dialogue.English: Everyone tells me that's terrible. That's why it makes me think even more that I wish I had someone who is more stable, not too free-spirited, and would consider my feelings.

dialogue.content: そうですねごめんなさいという言葉と決まってしまったのもあってどうしようもなかったのですがお土産なんかは考えてペアのものとか買ってきてくれてました
dialogue.English: Well, he did say 'I'm sorry,' and since it was already decided, there wasn't much he could do. But he was thoughtful about souvenirs and brought back matching items for us.

dialogue.content: やはり優しい彼氏さんですね…優しさって、とっても魅力的ですよね…
dialogue.English: He really is a kind boyfriend, isn't he... Kindness is such an attractive quality...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 私もそう思いますきっとしつこく言ったんで来年は大丈夫だといいなと次もそうならちょっと妥協して自分も自由に遊ぶか諦めて他にいくかの選択になるそうで
dialogue.English: I think so too. I'm sure I was persistent enough that it will be okay next year. If it happens again, I guess my choices will be to compromise and be more free myself, or give up and find someone else.

dialogue.content: そう思われているんですね。今の彼氏さんと、詳しく結婚の話はをされた事はありますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So that's how you're feeling. Have you ever talked about marriage in detail with your current boyfriend?

dialogue.content: ありますね
dialogue.English: Yes, we have.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。彼氏さんは、結婚に前向きな感じでしたでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. Did he seem positive about marriage?

dialogue.content: やはりお父さんいると言われてて結婚云々は置いといてきっと施設に完全に入れば一緒に過ごすことは可能なのかなとはおもいますが
dialogue.English: He mentioned his father, so setting aside the topic of marriage itself, I think perhaps if his father were to enter a full-time care facility, it might be possible for us to be together.

dialogue.content: そうですねずっと一人は淋しいと言ってたんで
dialogue.English: Yes, he did say he feels lonely being by himself all the time.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。淋しいとは、思われているんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So he is feeling lonely.

dialogue.content: みたいです
dialogue.English: It seems so.

dialogue.content: だいぶ先かもしれませんが余程いい人いなければ彼ととはおもうので
dialogue.English: It might be a long way off, but unless someone much better comes along, I think I'd like to be with him.

dialogue.content: 今日はお話し聞いてくれてありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you for listening to me today.

dialogue.content: そう思われているのですね！こちらこそありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: I understand that's how you feel! Thank you as well.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: また相談にきたときはよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: I'll be counting on you if I come back for another session.

dialogue.content: それではまた失礼致しますね
dialogue.English: Well then, goodbye for now.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、よろしくお願いいたします。ありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
dialogue.English: Likewise, I look forward to it. Thank you. Goodbye.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: （本日は、クライアント役ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for playing the client role today.)

dialogue.content: （色々ご指導頂けますよう、よろしくお願いいたします！）
dialogue.English: (I look forward to receiving your guidance and feedback!)

dialogue.content: 「こちらこそです」
dialogue.English: (Likewise.)

dialogue.content: 「またよろしくお願いいたします実話でしたw」
dialogue.English: "(I look forward to next time. It was a true story, lol.)"

dialogue.content: 「年齢だけ少しあげての」
dialogue.English: (I just raised my age a little.)

dialogue.content: 「またよろしくお願いいたします」
dialogue.English: (Looking forward to next time.)

dialogue.content: （そうなのですね！笑　色々な方に好かれて、なんだか羨ましいです…）
dialogue.English: (Is that so! (laughs) Being liked by so many different people, I'm a bit envious...)

dialogue.content: （絶対いい人をゲットしてください！　今後ともよろしくお願いたします。）
dialogue.English: (You should definitely get a great guy! I look forward to working with you in the future.)

dialogue.content: 「いえいえ全然ですでもちょうどネタにしてイロイロカウンセラーさんに聞くにもちょうどいいですw」
dialogue.English: "(Oh no, not at all. But it makes for good material to ask the counselors about various things, lol.)"

dialogue.content: 「ありがとうございます感謝」
dialogue.English: "(Thank you, I appreciate it.)"

dialogue.content: （本当にそうですよね笑　色々聞いちゃいましょう笑　では、本当にありがとうございました！　失礼いたします。)
dialogue.English: (That's so true, lol. Let's ask all sorts of things, lol. Well then, thank you so much again! Goodbye.)
